metadata.title: Asymptotically conical shrinking ends of the $r$-mean curvature flow: rotational construction and uniqueness
metadata.abstract: For $1\leq r\leq n-1$ we study shrinking self-similar ends of the $r$-mean curvature flow, $S_r=c\langle X,N\rangle$ with $c<0$, that are asymptotic to a cone. For every rotational cone of positive slope we construct a smooth embedded rotational end and prove that its profile is the only positive solution of the profile equation with the prescribed slope at infinity. Its angular defect $xu'-u$ is strictly negative, which yields $r$-admissibility, and the profile has a complete asymptotic expansion for $u(x)/x$ in powers of $x^{-(r+1)}$, valid after arbitrary differentiation. The profiles depend real analytically on the slope and, on sufficiently distant exterior regions, foliate the image of the corresponding family. Our main result removes the symmetry assumption: two ends that converge smoothly, with multiplicity one, to the same circular cone coincide outside a compact set. The proof transforms the equation for their difference into an almost-eigenfunction inequality for a drift Laplacian on an auxiliary conical metric and applies Bernstein's asymptotic analysis on weakly conical ends. The argument extends to strictly $r$-admissible cones whose links have constant principal curvatures.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: r-平均曲率收缩端构造唯一性
analysis.workSummary: 对 1≤r≤n−1 的 Sr=c〈X,N〉收缩方程，作者在任意正斜率圆锥上构造唯一正旋转轮廓，并给出轮廓偏差 O(x^(−r)) 及导数偏差 O(x^(−r−1))。同向定向、光滑单重渐近于同一圆锥的两个非对称端，在紧集外也必须重合。
techniques: Gårding 锥与 Newton 张量
漂移 Laplace 近特征函数
analysis.breakthrough: 把次数 r 的全非线性收缩方程的旋转构造推广到无对称假设的圆锥端唯一性。
analysis.limitations: 须 c<0、正斜率、1≤r≤n−1，并有所有阶光滑单重锥渐近及相同法向。端在无穷方向完备，不等于完整超曲面；一般 admissible 锥截面的唯一性仍开放。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露生成式 AI 用于语言编辑、组织表述，以及讨论和检查部分代数计算。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露生成式 AI 用于语言编辑、组织表述，以及讨论和检查部分代数计算。

analysis.priorityReason: 高阶曲率流收缩端的存在与无对称唯一性。
